verse.verse_1: I CALL TO WITNESS the Day of Resurrection,
verse.verse_2: And I call the reprehensive soul to witness:
verse.verse_3: Does man think We shall not put his bones together?
verse.verse_4: Surely We are able to reform even his finger-tips.
verse.verse_5: Yet man is sceptical of what is right before him.
verse.verse_6: He asks: "When will the Day of Resurrection be?"
verse.verse_7: Yet when the eyes are dazzled,
verse.verse_9: And the sun and moon are conjoined,
verse.verse_10: That day man will say: "Where can I find escape?"
verse.verse_11: Never so, for there will be no escape.
verse.verse_12: With your Lord alone will be the retreat on that day.
verse.verse_13: Then man will be told what he had sent ahead (of good) and what he had left behind.
verse.verse_14: In fact man is a witness against himself,
verse.verse_15: Whatever the excuses he may offer.
verse.verse_16: Do not forestall (the revelation before its completion) by acting in haste.
verse.verse_17: Surely its collection and recitation are Our responsibility.
verse.verse_18: So, as We recite it, follow its reading.
verse.verse_19: The exposition of its meaning surely rests on Us.
verse.verse_20: But no. You love this transient life,
verse.verse_22: How many faces will be refulgent on that Day,
verse.verse_24: And how many faces on that Day will be woe-begone
verse.verse_25: Fearing that a great disaster is going to befall them.
verse.verse_26: Never so, for when life withdraws into the clavicula,
verse.verse_27: And it is asked: "Is there any reciter of charms and amulets?"
verse.verse_28: He will then realise it is the parting,
verse.verse_29: And anguish will be heaped upon anguish:
verse.verse_30: To your Lord then will be the driving.
verse.verse_31: For he neither believed nor prayed,
verse.verse_32: But only disavowed and turned away;
verse.verse_33: Then he strutted back to his people.
verse.verse_34: Alas the woe for you, alas!
verse.verse_36: Does man think that he will be left alone to himself, free?
verse.verse_37: Was he not an emitted drop of semen,
verse.verse_38: Then formed into an embryo? Then He fashioned, shaped and proportioned
verse.verse_39: And assigned it sexes, male and female.
verse.verse_40: Cannot such as He bring the dead to life?
